# packages/sdk/src

TypeScript source for @prosodyai/sdk, the consumer SDK for the ProsodyAI API.

## Files

- `index.ts`: public export surface.
- `types.ts`, `types/`: wire payload types; wire field names are confined here.
- `step.ts`: `VoiceFrame`, one measured interval. Exposes `state`, `change`,
  and `vad` directly, plus `getProsody`, `getChange`, and the raw wire escape
  hatches (`getAcousticState`, `getAcousticChange`).
- `analysis.ts`: batch envelope validation and `ConversationAnalysis`.
- `conversation.ts`: `Conversation`, shared live/batch state model.
- `transcription.ts`: `Speaker`, `VoiceProfile`, `Transcription`.
- `conversation/prosody.ts`: owns the readable measurement shape
  (`Prosody`, `ProsodyState`, `ProsodyChange`, `MeasurementPath`) and the only
  wire-to-product key maps.
- `client.ts`, `session.ts`, `live-session.ts`, `realtime.ts`: transports.

## Contracts

- Product surface carries family-shaped names (`state.intonation.pitch`,
  `state.stress.loudness`, `state.rhythm.voiced`, `state.tilt`). Wire names
  (`f0_median_hz`, `rms_dbfs`) appear only in `types/` and in the maps inside
  `conversation/prosody.ts`.
- `state` is what was measured; `change` is what it moved against the speaker's
  own baseline. Both use the same family and field names.
- No unit suffixes or availability booleans on public names. A null field means
  the audio did not support the measurement.
